Metadata.title: Aegis — private search
Metadata.description: Private search engine with a local Meilisearch index and a server-side external provider shield. No logs, no cookies, no saved queries.

Home.subtitle: Start from your local index and, when needed, combine Brave, Exa, Serper and Tavily. No saved queries, no cookies, no profile.

local.title: Local Index
local.description: The pages from your crawl live in Meilisearch. Instant answers, with no external dependency while the index is enough.

shield.title: Multi-provider Shield
shield.description: Below three local results, the backend can combine Brave, Exa, Serper and Tavily, in fallback or in parallel. Keys stay on the server.

privacy.title: Zero Tracking
privacy.description: No cookies, no IP logs, no saved queries and no result cache.

Search.resultsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# result} other {# results}}
Search.noResultsHint: Try broader words, check the spelling, or enrich the local index with a new crawl.
Search.emptyIndexHint: Crawl a site, ingest the JSONL and search again. Inside Docker the file is /data/katana.jsonl.
Search.crawlScheduled: Background crawl started: this page will be indexed locally. Results may improve on the next searches.
Search.degraded: One of the sources was unreachable: the results shown may be partial.

errors.title: Could not complete the search
errors.unreachable: The search engine is unreachable. Check that the backend is running and try again.
errors.unavailable: The search sources are temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.invalidQuery: The query is not valid. Try different words.
errors.http: The search service returned an error ({status}).
errors.invalidResponse: The search service returned an unreadable response.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Try again in a moment.

preview.imageUnavailableDescription: The site refused the request or returned an unsupported image type. Check the backend logs.
preview.noImageDescription: This page does not expose og:image: a new crawl and index ingestion are required.

Filters.label: Local index filters
Filters.invalidDomain: Enter a valid domain, like example.com

Tor.disabled: Tor diagnostics disabled on the backend.
Tor.unreachable: The Tor proxy is not responding or is not a Tor exit node.

Footer.privacy: Aegis does not log IPs, cookies or queries. External links open without a referrer.

Error.title: Something went wrong
Error.description: The page could not load. No search data was recorded.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.
